title: Mayfair Self Employed Equity Release
h1: Mayfair Self Employed Equity Release (search-result title; H1 not independently confirmed)
summary: Case study of a prime residential refinance with equity release in Mayfair, Central London. The borrower was a Mayfair homeowner and business owner with high earnings who wanted to refinance his existing mortgage and release equity to buy a holiday home in Cannes, France. The security property was valued at £10 million and the client required a 75% loan-to-value. His income came mostly from his UK company, drawn as director's loans; earnings were described as high enough to meet typical bank affordability tests. The complication was an ongoing divorce, meaning any lender needed assurance about his asset base and income after separation. Silver Oak Capital placed the deal with a London-based lender that favours UK nationals and high-value Central London homes. Terms stated: £7.5 million mortgage, 75% LTV, variable rate of 2.25% over 3-month LIBOR, 5-year term, interest-only repayments. Challenge: self-employed/director's-loan income plus divorce. Outcome: £7.5m interest-only facility secured. Timing/publication date not confirmed by the search results.
